title: nondev mobile focused roguelike
author: Acidyo
selftext:
I built a roguelike game based on our main game's universe.

Meaning, we already had sprites made from different projects in the past, but everything else is AI generated such as the code, moves, abilities, vfx. 

I'm not a coder myself and haven't dev'd anything either, so thought it was quite impressive as to what I could achieve in just four days. Something that would've cost be thousands of $ in the past (believe me, there's been a lot of wasted $ in the past). 

Anyway, thought I'd share if anyone wants to test it and let me know their thoughts, it is available for Windows and Android currently:

https://acidyo.itch.io/holo-swarm

https://acidyo.itch.io/holo-swarm-mobile

the idea is a healer x creature, similar to our focus in our other games we've been building (main one is 3d and without AI which has taken years and hundreds of thousands of $ and is yet to be finished)

I'm new to everything AI so I've been experimenting with smaller games for now, babylon.js, godot, unity (although unity felt like it/I was slowing claude down a lot so have prefered godot) and thinking of looking what the bottleneck is with our main game here soon. 

Quite impressed so far I have to say. The game seems to run quite well and reminds me of games I've played on mobile before such as vampire survivors/pickle pete/etc.
